questions.question: A sum amounts to Rs. 9,261 in 3 years at 5% per annum, interest compounded annually. What is the simple interest (in Rs.) on the same sum for 3(3)/(4) years at the same rate of interest?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Principal = Rs. 9261

At CI, 3 years and 5% annum.

Formula:

SI = Ptimes R times Tover100

A = P × (1 + Rover 100)T

CI = A - P

Where, P = Principal, R = Rate, T = Time, A = Amount

Calculation:

Let the amount lent be 100.

Amount after 3 years at 5% compounding

⇒ 100 × (1 + 5over 100)3 = 115.7625

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7d1a75180bbfb8d62f8da8e36ee1f25039f3d3e213f55ce01f7a680a5c54ca68.png] 

Actual Sum = 100 × 9261over 115.7625 = Rs 8000

Interest on the actual sum for 3(3)/(4) years at 5% SI 

⇒ 8000times 5 times {15over4}over100 = Rs 1500

∴ The simple interest on the sum is Rs 1500.

questions.question: A train travels from place A to place B at a speed of 90 km/h and returns at a speed of 75 km/h. If it takes a total time of 14(2)/(3) hours, the distance between the places A and B is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Speed during A to B, S1 = 90 km/h

Speed during B to A, S2 = 75 km/h

Total time for up & down = 14 (2)/(3) hours

**Formula:**

D = S × T

Where D = Distance, S = Speed, T = Time

Sₐvg = S₁S₂over S₁+S₂

Where, S₁ and S₂ are the speeds during the journey from A to B and B to A respectively.

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

⇒ Savg = 90 × 75over 90+75 = 450over11 km/hr

Now, Distance between A to B

⇒ D = 450over11 × 14(2)/(3) = 450over11 × (44)/(3) = 600 km

**∴ The total distance between A and B is 600 km.**

questions.question: Out of six numbers A, B, C, D, E and F, the average of first five numbers A, B, C, D and E is greater than the average of last five numbers B, C, D, E and F by 26. The difference between A and F is:
questions.solution:
**Formula:**

Average = Sum of the numbers ÷ Total numbers

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

⇒ A+B+C+D+Eover5 - B+C+D+E+Fover5 = 26

⇒ A+B+C+D+E-B-C-D-E-Fover5 = 26

⇒ A-Fover5 = 26

⇒ A - F = 26 × 5 = 130

**∴ The difference between A and F is 130.**

questions.question: ​The ratio of two numbers x and y is 4 ∶ 7. If 6 is added to x and 7 is subtracted from y, then their ratio becomes 3 ∶ 4. What is the difference between y and x?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Let the common ratio be a unit.

⇒ The numbers x and y are 4a and 7a respectively.

According to the question,

⇒ 4a+6over7a-7 = 3over4

⇒ 4 × (4a + 6) = 3 × (7a - 7)

⇒ 16a + 24 = 21a - 21

⇒ 24 + 21 = 21a - 16a

⇒ 45 = 5a

⇒ a = 9

Difference between y and x = 7a - 4a = 3a

⇒ Difference = 3 × 9 = 27 

**∴ The difference is 27.**

questions.question: Radha saves 28% of her income. If her expenditure increases by 25% and savings increase by 30%, then by what percentage will her income increase?
questions.solution:
Given:

Savings = 28% of expenditure

Increase in savings = 30%

Increase in expenditure = 25%

Formula:

Income = Savings + Expenditure

Calculation:

Let income be 100 units.

Savings = Rs 28

∴ Expenditure = 100 - 28 = Rs 72.

According to the question,

New expenditure = 1.25 × 72 = Rs 90.

New savings = 1.30 × 28 = Rs 36.4

New Income = 90 + 36.4 = Rs 126.4

⇒ Increase in income = 126.4 - 100 = Rs 26.4

% increase = 26.4over100 × 100 = 26.4%

∴ There is a 26.4% increase in income.

questions.question: A shopkeeper decides to sell a certain item at a certain price. He tags the price on the item by increasing the decided price by 45%. While selling the item, he offers 40% discount. Find how much more or less he gets on the decided price.
questions.solution:
Formula :

SP = MP × (1 - D%)

Where, MP = Marked Price, D% = Discount Percentage

Calculation:

Let the cost price be 100 units

⇒ MP = (1 + 45over100) × 100 = 145 units

According to the question, 

SP = 145 × (1 - 40over100) = 87 units

∴ Net decrease in the price = 87 - 100 = -13 units

So, In percentage = (13units /100 units) × 100 = 13%

∴ The shopkeeper gets 13% less on the decided price.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

The negative sign in the answer is for representational purposes. The presence of the negative sign shows that the shopkeeper sold the product at a cost lesser than the original cost i.e., incurred a loss.

questions.question: Pipes A, B and C can fill a tank in 10, 15 and 18 hours, respectively. A and C are opened for 5 hours, then only pipe A is closed and B is opened at the same time (with C). The total time taken to fill the tank completely is:
questions.solution:
Formula:

Efficiency = Total work done/ total time taken

Calculation:

Let the volume of the tank

⇒ LCM of 5, 10, 15, and 18 = 90 units

Efficiency of A = 90/10 = 9 units/hr

Efficiency of B = 90/15 = 6 units/hr

Efficiency of C = 90/18 = 5 units/hr

Total volume filled by A and C in 5 hours

⇒ (9 + 5) × 5 = 70 units

Remaining volume = 90 - 70 = 20 units 

Total volume filled by B and C in 1 hour

⇒ 6 + 5 = 11 units/hr

Time taken to fill the remaining volume by B and C

⇒ 20over11 = 19over11 hours

∴ Time taken to fill the complete tank = 5 + 19over11 = 69over11 hours

∴ The total time taken to fill the tank is 69over11 **hours.**

questions.question: The LCM of two positive numbers is 6 times their HCF. The sum of HCF and LCM is 189. If one number is 54, then the other number is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The ratio of HCF to LCM is 1 : 6, so total parts = 1 + 6 = 7.

7 parts = 189 ⇒ 1 part (HCF) = 27 and 6 parts (LCM) = 162.

Using the rule: Number₁ × Number₂ = LCM × HCF

54 × Number₂ = 162 × 27

Number₂ = (162 × 27) ÷ 54 = 81

**∴ The correct answer is 81.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

LCM = 6 × HCF

LCM + HCF = 189

First Number = 54

**Formula Used:**

LCM × HCF = Product of the two numbers

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3278d880393490be919ddbe808c57e2be0345ee1c43d516cc7da0ce9e018770f.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the HCF be x.

⇒ LCM = 6x

⇒ LCM + HCF = 189

⇒ 6x + x = 189

⇒ 7x = 189

⇒ x = 189 ÷ 7 = 27

⇒ So, HCF = 27 and LCM = 6 × 27 = 162

⇒ Now, First Number × Second Number = LCM × HCF

⇒ 54 × Second Number = 162 × 27

⇒ Second Number = (162 × 27) ÷ 54

⇒ Second Number = 162 × (27 ÷ 54)

⇒ Second Number = 162 ÷ 2 = 81

**∴ The correct answer is 81.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Product Rule of HCF and LCM

For any two positive integers a and b, the product of the numbers is equal to the product of their HCF and LCM. Formula: a × b = HCF(a, b) × LCM(a, b).

Co-prime Property

If two numbers are expressed as H × x and H × y (where H is their HCF), then x and y must be co-prime to each other. Their LCM is mathematically given by H × x × y.

Fractions HCF and LCM

HCF of fractions = (HCF of Numerators) ÷ (LCM of Denominators). LCM of fractions = (LCM of Numerators) ÷ (HCF of Denominators).

questions.question: A person travels equal distances at speeds of 3 km/h, 4 km/h, 5 km/h and 6 km/h, and takes a total time of 3 hours 48 minutes. The total distance (in km) is:
questions.solution:
**Formula:**

D = S × T

Where, D = Distance traveled, S = Speed, T = Time taken

Calculation:

Time in hours = 348over60 = 3{4over5} = {19over5} hours

Let the distance be "d".

Time taken for walking at 3 km/h = dover 3

Time taken for walking at 4 km/h = dover 4

Time taken for walking at 5 km/h = dover 5

Time taken for walking at 6 km/h = dover 6

Total time taken = dover 3 + dover 4 + dover 5 + dover 6 = 57dover 60

According to the question,

⇒ 57dover 60 = {19over5}

⇒ d = 60× 19over 57× 5 = 4 km

So, Total distance traveled = 4d = 4 × 4 = 16 km.

**∴ The** total distance is 16 km.

questions.question: The surface areas of three coterminous faces of a cuboid are 5 cm2, 16 cm2 and 20 cm2 respectively. Find the volume of the cuboid.
questions.solution:
**Formula:**

V = lbh

Where, V = volume of the cuboid

l, b, and h are the sides of the cuboid respectively.

**Concept:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/86e92b802ab713900c79f8552cce344623de536ab6f08439d631d1e500a565f0.png] 

In the figure above, three coterminous sides (highlighted in bold color) are faces ADEF, ABCD, and ABEG

From the figure,

⇒ Area of ADEF = b × h = bh

⇒ Area of ABCD = l × b = lb

⇒ Area of ABEG = l × h = lh

∴ Product of the area of coterminous faces = bh × lb × lh = l²b²h² = (lbh)²

Taking the square root of the product = lbh = volume of the cuboid

**Calculation:**

Product of the area of coterminous faces 

⇒ 5 cm2 × 16 cm2 × 20 cm2 = 1600 cm⁶

Volume of the cuboid = √(1600 cm⁶) = 40 cm³

**∴ The volume of the cuboid is 40 cm3**.
